name: JW Marriott Grosvenor House London
positioning: Historic 1929 hotel on Park Lane in Mayfair, directly across from Hyde Park, with one of Europe's largest hotel ballrooms
best_for: Travelers who want a Mayfair base facing Hyde Park
Guests drawn to a hotel with royal and society history
Families wanting family rooms and suites in central London

facts.text: The hotel is on Park Lane in the heart of Mayfair, near Hyde Park.
Grosvenor House sits directly across Park Lane from Hyde Park.
The former home of the Dukes of Westminster and Gloucester was designed and rebuilt as a hotel in 1929 by architects L. Rome Guthrie and Sir Edwin Lutyens.
The Great Room is one of Europe's largest hotel ballrooms, seating up to 2000 guests for dinner.
Rooms take cues from autumn and spring in Hyde Park, while suites use a palette of warm neutrals.
Park View Suites have a king-size bedroom and a separate living room overlooking Hyde Park and Park Lane.
The hotel has a Les Clefs D'or concierge team.
The fitness suite is open 24 hours a day and has quiet spaces for yoga.
The JW Marriott Executive Lounge offers all-day service, breakfast, afternoon tea, canapes and drinks.
JW Steakhouse serves prime USDA beef and takes inspiration from New York.
The JW Garden has views of Hyde Park and a bespoke allotment-style 10 ft dinner table.
Conde Nast Traveler notes the classic entrance colonnade joining two towers.

highlights.text: The former home of the Dukes of Westminster and Gloucester was rebuilt as a hotel in 1929 by architects L. Rome Guthrie and Sir Edwin Lutyens.
The Great Room was once an ice rink where the late Queen Elizabeth II and her sister Margaret learnt to skate as children.
Suites have pillowtop beds, marble bathrooms and views of Hyde Park, and some have private balconies.
The Les Clefs D'or concierge team can arrange experiences such as guided wellbeing walks in Mayfair and horseback riding in Hyde Park.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the busy Park Lane location brings urban traffic noise.
Executive Lounge access depends on the room booked or Marriott Bonvoy elite status.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury London market.
